messages: anya: quick sync on playground streaming UX. proposals: move token counter into composer as a collapsing pill, Stop should preserve partial as a local draft overlay, Pause should suspend the stream client-side, and add Cmd+I for prompt quick-insert. figma: https://figma.com/redwood/playground-stream-compact ben: Inline controls look cleaner. microcopy candidates: Pause / Stop (save draft) / Regenerate. Token pill: live count while streaming, icon when idle, +N delta after regen. maria: product constraints: preserved partials must be client-only until user applies. Regenerate should spawn a new generation entry and run against visible composer text if edited. Add revert in the draft menu. sam: backend notes: Stop = server cancel + emit final tokens_consumed (aborted=true when early). Pause = client pause; may need keepalive ping. I'll add generation.outcome tag. linda: a11y checklist: controls must be tabbable; token pill should use role=status and aria-live=polite. Announce: "Generation stopped 1 partial content saved as draft." Example: ``` Tokens: 104 ``` ben: QA: test mobile collapse at 360px and keyboard nav for prompt drawer. anya: action items: ben update figma frames (EOD), sam spike abort/tag + final-token event (2d), maria draft flow + menu copy (1d), linda compile a11y snippets (2d). follow-up Fri 9am PT. deploy-bot: Reminder: "Playground streaming design review" Fri 09:00 PT. RSVP here. anya: thanks all, keeping thread open for quick comments.
